title: docs(readme): show what Object UI renders + slim and reposition
body:
## What

Object UI is a UI engine whose README had **no screenshots** (the only images were badges), plus a few inconsistencies. This shows what it renders and tightens the page.

- **Positioning** — a "What is Object UI?" section places it as the **View layer** of the ObjectStack ecosystem (`describe → ObjectStack` / `render → Object UI` / `run → ObjectOS`), usable standalone with any backend like Amis/Formily.
- **Screenshots** — a JSON-schema → rendered-UI hero, plus a gallery of rendered views (dashboard, Gantt, kanban, calendar) and the visual designers.
- **Accuracy** — fixes the "39 packages published" vs "not yet published to NPM" contradiction; removes the duplicate Quick Start and unverifiable marketing claims (3x/6x/85%); drops the version-specific "What's New" changelog block.
- 607 → 521 lines.

Docs-only.
